footnote_text: Each restricted share unit represents a contingent right to receive one ordinary share of the Issuer, an equivalent amount of cash, or a combination thereof. Reflects vested restricted share units that settled into ordinary shares of the Issuer on a one-for-one basis. These restricted share units vested in full on the date of the 2026 annual general meeting of shareholders.
